card: Adds a Python implementation of BIP 352 (silent payments) scanning to the functional test framework, validated against official BIP 352 receiving test vectors. It enables functional tests to detect and verify silent payment outputs independently of node logic. This utility is extracted from PR 35302 (Silent Payments sending) to simplify review of that feature.
evidence: "Picked from #35302 as an isolated change that can be evaluated independently. This should make #35302 a bit easier to review." (PR description)
problem: Functional test coverage for silent payments features (such as sending in #35302) lacks an independent Python-level scanner to inspect and assert against generated silent payment outputs.

risk.why: Touches only functional test library code and tests, posing no risk to consensus, wallet security, or node operation.

scope_notes: Extracted as an independent testing component from #35302 to reduce review overhead on that PR.
summary: Adds a Python implementation of BIP 352 (silent payments) scanning without labels to the functional test framework. It tests this scanner implementation against the official BIP 352 receiving test vectors so functional tests can verify silent payment outputs independently of bitcoind.
